notes.title: Cognition: Game of the Year Edition is Now Available!
notes.content: We've just released the new Cognition: Game of the Year Edition! Released in celebration of winning six 2013 Reader's Choice Aggie Awards, including Best Adventure Game of 2013, the GOTY edition includes all 4 episodes of Season 1, now with director and designer commentary, concept art, storyboards, outtakes, videos and more exclusive looks behind the scenes and stories from development. This new edition has been marked down to $14.99, and also now comes with Volume 1 of the award-winning soundtrack by Austin Haynes, featuring the single "The Taking" by Robert and Raleigh Holmes.

notes.title: Cognition: Game of the Year Edition!
notes.content:
[img]https://38.media.tumblr.com/f6dc22ecb8fea928ff51b362f1a1f200/tumblr_n9sixexaSe1ssv2soo1_1280.png[/img]
We're very excited today to announce the release of Cognition: Game of the Year Edition! 

Thanks to the amazing support of our community, Cognition won SIX 2013 Reader's Choice Aggie Awards this year, including Best Adventure Game! In celebration, we've added a ton of new bonus content - director commentary, concept art, videos, outtakes, and more! Plus some bug fixes while we were at it. :) 

The GOTY edition has been marked down to $14.99, and also now comes with Volume 1 of the award-winning soundtrack by Austin Haynes, featuring the single "The Taking" by Robert and Raleigh Holmes. 

[img]https://38.media.tumblr.com/f80a60939461cf85748a1a6457ec4097/tumblr_n9sj1d9l0t1ssv2soo1_1280.jpg[/img]

We hope you enjoy the new edition of the game and thank as always for your amazing support of Phoenix Online & Cognition!

notes.title: Jane Jensen's Moebius Available Now!
notes.content:
[url=http://store.steampowered.com/app/264520/]Moebius: Empire Rising[/url] is the first in an all-new series of paranormal mystery adventures from award-winning game designer Jane Jensen, creator of the bestselling Gabriel Knight series and Gray Matter. Step into the shoes of Malachi Rector, a brilliant antiques dealer and historian whose photographic memory and eye for deduction transforms locations and clues into interactive puzzle pieces and historical patterns.

Players will criss-cross the globe’s most exotic locales as they solve challenging riddles, search for hidden clues, and connect evidence and events to uncover a global conspiracy that threatens to bring worldwide ruin.

notes.title: Now Available - Cognition: An Erica Reed Thriller
notes.content:
Cognition: An Erica Reed Thriller is Now Available on Steam and is 25% off.

FBI agent Erica Reed has an uncanny talent: she can see the past and piece together how a crime unfolded. But not even this sixth sense could save her younger brother, Scott, from a brutal serial killer. Three years later, the investigation into Scott’s murder has gone cold -- but Erica’s work has only just begun.

Jump into Cognition: An Erica Reed Thriller, the exciting four-part series that brings Erica face to face with the deranged demons of her past. A serial killer is loose in Boston -- one who seems to be leaving deliberate clues that only Erica, with her unique post-cognitive abilities, can uncover. Is she finally on her way to solving Scott’s murder? Or, blinded by vengeance, is she falling into a trap that could cost Erica her life? And how does this new killer know her secret?

*Offer ends September 26th at 10AM Pacific Time
